hero.title: Master the 999 Call Before an Emergency Strikes.
hero.subtitle: Bobby is the interactive AI tutor that trains children (ages 5-12) to handle police, fire, and ambulance calls with confidence. Practice realistic voice simulations and learn critical safety protocols in a secure environment.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to emergency readiness

step1.title: Choose Age Level
step1.description: Select the appropriate age group (5-7, 7-10, or 11-12) to get age-appropriate scenarios and language complexity.

step2.title: Pick Emergency Type
step2.description: Choose from fire, ambulance, or police scenarios. Each situation is designed to teach specific emergency response skills.

step3.title: Practice with Bobby
step3.description: Have a realistic voice conversation with Bobby, our AI emergency operator. Get instant feedback and earn points for clear communication.

carousel.title: Could your child handle...
carousel.subtitle: Swipe to see real scenarios children can practice with Bobby

1.hook: Would your child know what to tell the ambulance?
1.description: Your child comes home to find you unresponsive on the floor. Bobby will guide them through checking if you're breathing, giving the address, and staying calm until help arrives.
practicePoints: Staying on the line until help arrives

2.situation: You wake up and smell smoke
2.hook: Get out first? Call first? Do they know?
2.description: It's the middle of the night and smoke fills the hallway. Bobby teaches them the right order of actions and how to escape safely.

3.situation: There's a stranger in the house
3.hook: Could they stay hidden and whisper for help?
3.description: Someone has broken in while the family is home. Bobby helps them understand how to hide, stay quiet, and communicate with emergency services.

4.situation: Grandad fell and won't get up
4.hook: Can they describe what happened clearly?
4.description: Grandad has had a fall and can't move. Bobby guides them through describing the situation, checking for injuries, and keeping Grandad comfortable.

5.situation: The neighbour's house is on fire
5.hook: Do they know what THEY should do?
5.description: Flames are visible next door. Bobby teaches them to alert their own family, call for help, and stay away from danger.

6.hook: Every second counts. Would they freeze?
6.description: A sibling is choking on food and can't breathe. Bobby walks them through recognising the signs and getting help immediately.

1.question: What is this app for?
1.answer: Bobby helps kids practice calling 999 in a safe, fun way. It teaches children how to communicate clearly, stay calm, and understand when and how to call for help.

2.question: How do the age scenarios work?
2.answer: The app offers three age tiers: Ages 5-7 (very simple language and short scenarios), Ages 8-10 (more realistic conversations), and Ages 11-12 (near-realistic operator flow).

3.question: Is my child's data safe?
3.answer: Yes! We store minimal data locally on your device only. No sensitive information is collected or stored. We only track scenario completion, XP, and badges to make learning fun.

4.question: Will this call real emergency services?
4.answer: No! Bobby is a training app only - it will NEVER connect to real emergency services. It's a safe environment for practice.

5.question: How many practice calls are included?
5.answer: Each credit gives you one practice call with Bobby. You can choose from different packages based on how much practice your child needs. All calls are guided and age-appropriate.

6.question: How long does one credit last?
6.answer: Each credit gives you one complete practice call with Bobby. The conversation should last at least 30 seconds to be considered a valid practice session. If a call ends too early, the credit won't be deducted.

7.question: What happens if I lose connection during a call?
7.answer: If you get disconnected, don't worry! The system tracks your conversation progress. Reconnect within 5 minutes and you may be able to continue. If the issue persists, contact support.

8.question: Can I get a refund for unused credits?
8.answer: Credits are non-refundable but don't expire! You can use them anytime for practice sessions with any emergency scenario.

9.question: Do credits expire?
9.answer: No, your credits never expire. Use them whenever you're ready to practice.

10.question: What browsers are supported?
10.answer: Bobby works best on modern browsers like Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. We recommend using the latest version for the best experience.

11.question: Do I need a microphone?
11.answer: Yes, a microphone is required for voice conversations with Bobby. Make sure you grant microphone permission when prompted.

12.question: How is my child's data protected?
12.answer: We use secure authentication and never store personal information like addresses or phone numbers. Conversations are used only for assessment and progress tracking.

13.question: Can other users see my child's conversations?
13.answer: No, all conversations are private and only visible to your account.

14.question: How does the scoring system work?
14.answer: Children are scored on clarity, providing location, describing the emergency, and staying calm. Scores range from 0-100, with higher scores earning more XP points.

15.question: What are XP and badges?
15.answer: XP (Experience Points) are earned by completing practice calls. As XP accumulates, children level up and earn badges for achievements like 'Clear Communicator' or 'Fire Safety Expert.'

16.question: Can we replay conversations?
16.answer: Yes! You can review past conversations in the 'Chats' section to see progress and review feedback.

17.question: How is feedback generated?
17.answer: Our AI system analyzes conversations based on age-appropriate criteria and provides personalized feedback on what went well and areas for improvement.

18.question: What accessibility features are available?
18.answer: Bobby offers dyslexia-friendly fonts, adjustable text sizes, high contrast mode, slowed speech options, and reduced sensory mode for children with sensory sensitivities.

19.question: Can my child practice if they have speech difficulties?
19.answer: Yes! We offer text-based input alternatives and visual aids. The slowed speech mode helps with comprehension.

20.question: Can I use Google to sign in?
20.answer: Yes! You can sign up or log in using your Google account for quick access.

21.question: How do I reset my password?
21.answer: Click 'Password playing hide and seek?' on the login page, enter your email, and we'll send a reset link.

22.question: Can I have multiple children on one account?
22.answer: Currently, each account tracks progress for one user. For multiple children, create separate accounts to track individual progress.

23.question: How do I delete my account?
23.answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. This permanently removes all data, progress, and credits.

24.question: Voice isn't working - what should I do?
24.answer: Check that your microphone is connected and permissions are granted. Try refreshing the page or using a different browser.

25.question: The app seems stuck or frozen.
25.answer: Try refreshing the page. If problems persist, clear your browser cache or contact support.
